lines.zh: 金发竖起来，走路都带风
lines.en: Golden hair up, even my walk has a breeze.

lines.zh: 气在脚底炸开，我滑过去
lines.en: Ki bursts underfoot and I slide on.

lines.zh: 超赛形态，连步幅都变了
lines.en: Super Saiyan changes even my stride.
Half a block up, drifting forward.
Hair standing stiff against the wind.
That golden glow walks with me.
Grass scorches where I pass.
Ki waves push ahead; I ride them.

lines.zh: 合体加超赛，走路都嚣张
lines.en: Fusion plus Super Saiyan: even walking is cocky.
One step, and an afterimage remains.
The glow won't fade; I can't settle.

lines.zh: 超赛状态下站着也在耗气
lines.en: Standing in this form burns ki.

lines.zh: 我的头发现在很难打理
lines.en: My hair is a nightmare to manage now.
I can't hold this form long.
My ki keeps rising; I can't cap it.
Green eyes, gold hair, hard to miss.
I'm not angry; this is just my look.
The ki inside keeps churning.

lines.zh: 站着不动也能感觉地面在抖
lines.en: Even standing, I feel the ground tremble.
A little longer and I can go further.

lines.zh: 这形态是给硬仗准备的
lines.en: This form is for hard fights.
The glow turns everything yellow.
I'm rationing my ki.
The transformation's aftershock lingers.
What you see now is a Super Saiyan.

lines.zh: 我的气比刚才厚了一倍
lines.en: My ki is twice as thick as before.

lines.zh: 金光照着你，看清楚了吗
lines.en: The golden light's on you; see clearly?
You still dare stand there.
My eyes turned green; don't misread it.

lines.zh: 这个形态下我耐性更差
lines.en: I'm less patient in this form.
You're backing off faster than before.
I raise a hand and ki gathers.
Your ki looks faint to me.
Don't judge me by my earlier self.
Hair standing up isn't a bluff.

lines.zh: 我这形态，只维持一小会
lines.en: I hold this form only briefly.
Come closer if you want a good look.

lines.zh: 我在掂量你值不值得变
lines.en: Weighing whether you're worth this form.
The aura burns; mind your feet.
The earlier me was easier to talk to.
Your face says regret.
Apologizing now would still work.
The golden glow flickered.
Just clipped, not heavy.
This form doesn't block everything.
Fine, you've got some skill.
Small body, and no small ki.
I didn't expect that move.
It hurts, but I can still go further.
I'll read the next one.
Don't gloat; I'm not at my limit.

lines.zh: 吃东西？这形态消耗更大
lines.en: Food? This form burns even more.
I need to eat to steady my ki.
That little bit won't cover it.
I get hungry fast after transforming.
After this fight I'll eat.
Golden aura doesn't block the smell.
I'm not bribed; I'm resupplying.
Bring more than that.

lines.zh: 这具身体要养两份胃口
lines.en: This body feeds two appetites.
Smells good; save it.

lines.zh: 我身上的气把你弹开了
lines.en: My aura bounced you away.
Don't touch; this aura is hot.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你的手该麻了
lines.en: Bump me and your hand should be numb.
I float above ground; you can't reach.

lines.zh: 金光一闪，你已经错位了
lines.en: A flash of gold, and you're out of place.
Make way; I don't want to hold back.
That was just a graze.
I cracked the ground with that step.
The ki wave pushed you off.
This form doesn't ease off.
No such thoughts in this form.
I have a fight to finish first.

lines.zh: 你找的是两个小孩，不是这个
lines.en: You want the two kids, not this.
Under this glow, what partner talk?
My ki's too hot; stay back.

lines.zh: 变身有代价，我不想连累谁
lines.en: Transforming costs me; I won't drag anyone in.
Ask me after I power down.

lines.zh: 我这份力量，不适合分享
lines.en: This power isn't for sharing.
Time's short; no detours.
Win first, think later.
A pull of ki and it's in my hand.

lines.zh: 金光下，地上的东西很显眼
lines.en: Under this glow, ground items stand out.
I pick things up faster now.
I raise a hand and it floats up.
Ki alone handles this weight.
Don't grab it; I won't chase.
Grabbed it in passing.

lines.zh: 变身之后动作都变利落
lines.en: Everything's sharper after transforming.
I'll keep what's on the ground.
One bean, saved for the right moment.

lines.zh: 超赛的怒火，你受得住吗
lines.en: Can you take a Super Saiyan's rage?
Now I'll actually get serious.
My ki surges, hair stiffer still.
Double speed; you can't keep up.

lines.zh: 这一拳会比刚才重得多
lines.en: This punch lands far heavier.
Green eyes locked; no escape.
I grant you the right to regret.
My ki blasts are lined up.
Don't expect mercy.

lines.zh: 三百点生命，现在更耐打
lines.en: Three hundred points, and tougher now.
Kamehameha charged.
I've read you three steps ahead.
I entered this form for you.
That earlier round was a warm-up.
The aura is blazing.
Golden afterimages surround you.
I won't come from the front.
A volley of ki blasts pins you down.
The moment you turn, I'm there.
Climbing for a better angle.

lines.zh: 这形态下我更快，也更急
lines.en: Faster and more impatient in this form.
The golden glare makes you squint; perfect.
The shadow on the ground is mine.
Ki gathers at my fingertip.
Two more blocks and you're through.
I don't need to dodge; I'm faster.

lines.zh: 每次呼吸都在缩短距离
lines.en: Every breath closes the gap.
Setting up an aerial combo.
This is the afterimage fist; watch.
You're already surrounded.

lines.zh: 我压着气，等你的脚挪动。
lines.en: I hold my ki in check, waiting for your foot to shift.

lines.zh: 金色的光晃得你眼花吧
lines.en: The golden light blurring your eyes?
A charged dash, wreathed in gold.
Aerial combo, second hit.
Even the punch wind burns.

lines.zh: 超赛的拳头，重量不一样
lines.en: A Super Saiyan fist weighs differently.
Ten hits straight; don't bother counting.
I slam down from above.
Afterimages scatter before your eyes.
My kick carries a ki edge.
This one sends you flying.
Combo into ki blast to finish.
I'm faster than your reflexes.
My green eyes never leave you.
A flash of gold, and the fist lands.
The ground craters under my hit.
This punch is called Super Saiyan.
My hair snaps straight up.

lines.zh: 金色的气从脚底冲上来
lines.en: Golden ki erupts from my feet.

lines.zh: 合体之后，我又上了一层
lines.en: After fusion, I climbed another level.
A scene like this needs this glow.
Super Saiyan Gotenks has arrived.
The wind around me turns golden.
Ki pressure cracks the ground.

lines.zh: 我先把头发理好，虽然没用
lines.en: Fixing my hair first, though it won't help.
I can't hold this form for long.
The aura shoots skyward.

lines.zh: 我还没出拳，你已经退了
lines.en: I haven't punched and you've stepped back.

lines.zh: 变身的余波把尘土吹散
lines.en: The aftershock blows the dust away.
Two kids, now fiercer.
I'm here, and I brought light.
This one needs to be quick.
Don't stand and watch; you'll be caught.
Gold light lands, and I take shape.

lines.zh: 名字还是那个，力气翻倍
lines.en: Same name, double the force.
The flames burned through my aura.
Hit the ground; half my ki scattered.
Who'd have thought I'd drown.
The blast threw me far.
Something pierced my ki shield.
This isn't ki; it's something else.
Hunger dims even this glow.
Lightning fought my ki.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，金光也托不住我
lines.en: The ground's gone, and my glow can't hold me.
